message: We'll set up a private, encrypted, versioned Amazon S3 bucket for synthetic test documents, accessed only by your existing IAM operator. I've proposed Sydney (ap-southeast-2) for now, but it isn't an approved region and I haven't checked availability. I've assumed the operator needs to both upload and read files. Which country should the test documents stay in? If it's Australia, Sydney fits.

proposal.title: Private S3 document store for synthetic deployment test
proposal.body: Scope: storage only, with no AI, database or web app. The diagram has one proposed Amazon S3 bucket (all public access blocked, encryption on, versioning on) and the existing IAM operator who reaches it through a typed s3-read-write grant. The principal ARN is a required Terraform input and is not verified. Assumptions: Sydney (ap-southeast-2) is a candidate region only, not approved. The documents are synthetic. Nothing is deployed.

data.label: Test operator (existing IAM principal)
data.description: An existing IAM role or user outside the provisioning scope. It uploads and reads the synthetic documents. Its ARN is supplied as a reviewable input and is not verified here.

data.label: Synthetic document bucket
data.description: A private S3 bucket. All four Block Public Access settings are on, server-side encryption is on, versioning is enabled and a bucket policy grants access only to the bound operator. It holds synthetic text documents only.

requirementDrafts.rationale: Without these controls, the test documents could be exposed or lost if they are overwritten.
requirementDrafts.basis: User: "Keep public access blocked and enable encryption and versioning."
requirementDrafts.statement: Proposed: the document bucket blocks all public access, encrypts objects at rest and keeps object versions.

requirementDrafts.rationale: Private storage needs an explicit access contract. Otherwise the bucket is unusable, or access ends up too broad.
requirementDrafts.basis: User: "a private place on AWS to store a small set of synthetic text documents"
requirementDrafts.statement: Proposed: only the named existing operator can store and read documents. Any other identity is denied.

requirementDrafts.rationale: The country drives where the bucket can be placed. Choosing a region before agreeing the country risks rework.
requirementDrafts.basis: User: "Propose Sydney as a candidate region, but do not record that as an approved deployment region."
requirementDrafts.statement: Proposed: the test documents stay in a country we agree on. Sydney (ap-southeast-2) is a candidate region only, pending approval.
